fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CATEGORY OF INSTITUTION
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc

fields.name: INSTITUTION'S CODE
fields.description: The code of the institution submitting fraudulent activities E.g. {KCB = 01}

fields.name: INSTITUTION'S NAME
fields.description: The name of the institution submitting the fraudulet activities

fields.name: NUMBER OF FRAUDULENT ACTIVITIES
fields.description: The count on the number of fraudulent activities per institution

fields.name: AMOUNT INVOLVED
fields.description: The amount involved in the fraudulent activity

fields.name: AMOUNT OF LOSS
fields.description: Actual loss amount to the institution in Local currency (Kshs')
